one_liner: Zoho CRM has a broad REST API (v8) with standard OAuth 2.0 auth-code flow, self-serve API console, free developer edition, and an official vendor MCP.
auth_notes: Authorization-code flow with client registration at api-console.zoho.com (Server-based or Self Client); also client-credentials flow. Multi-datacenter accounts URLs; tokens are org-specific.
access_notes: Free edition and free Developer Edition available; sources conflict on whether Free plan has full API (one says API included on all plans, another says limited). Developer Edition and trial give a safe path.
blocker_notes: Minor: data-center-specific accounts URLs, per-org tokens, credit-based rate limits; not blockers.

evidence.quote: The Zoho CRM API uses the **OAuth 2.0** protocol for authentication.
The Zoho CRM APIs use the authorization code grant type to provide access to protected resources.
Go to [Zoho API console](https://api-console.zoho.com/) and click on **Add Client**
There is no separate developer signup, no enterprise gate, and no approval process.
Zoho also offers a [free Developer Edition](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/developer-edition.html), a full CRM instance for building and testing
Zoho CRM's** API is a mature REST surface, now on its [eighth major version]
a Bulk API for asynchronous high-volume operations, a COQL query language for SQL-style record retrieval, and a Notification API for event-driven integrations.
Zoho CRM provides these as pre-built MCP servers, so you don't need to build, host, or maintain any infrastructure.
